_original_lore: The Star Sentry is a mob that spawns near
fallen star in the Dwarven Mines (random event).
The Star Sentry takes 1 health per hit.
Fallen Star Event spawns in one of the
following locations: Royal Mines, Far Reserve,
Goblin Burrows, Upper Mines, Rampart's Quarry,
Great Ice Wall and the Cliffside Veins.
